description: No clean concept found. The most enriched single pattern is column 0 (leftmost) holding only the second player's stones (one or two of them, nothing else in that column), but this covers only ~40% of firing at low precision. Activation swings strongly with the exact last move and ply parity; it does not fire when column 0 is empty or tall, and is often suppressed right after a stone is dropped into column 0.
effect: None measurable: forcing the unit to zero or to its max changes move probabilities by at most 0.01 on 5 positions.
notes: Layer 1 unit. Histograms: top band is odd ply 15-19, column 0 = one second-player stone, their stones stacked in column 1, last move landing high. Tested: opponent vertical three in col1 (no), deep well in col2 (no), column fill (no). Scores: p1 F1 0.12, p2 (col0 second-player-only) F1 0.146 AUROC 0.64 (best), p3 0.117, p4 0.145; simulation share ~0. Activation is highly context and last-move dependent; likely a distributed or random direction. Synthesis found by search over 2-move extensions of a dev top position (1.48 > dev max 1.29).
